batch.rule: Every event needs a filed debit/credit setup before it can run. A quotation or policy is processed only while alive: lapse, full withdrawal, surrender, maturity, claim-out, expired or declined stops all later batches (reported as skipped-terminal). Clawback is the exception — it targets leavers to recover commission. Re-running a period is safe: job + period + subject is the idempotency key.

entries.title: Access & DOA and Role access matrix tabs restricted to Administration only
entries.why: Role governance, Tab → Section → Sub-Section permission trees and DOA matrix administration belong exclusively to the executive Administration profile and should not appear in operational, supervisor, manager, broker, bancassurance or partner workspaces.
entries.what: Deleted Access & DOA (access-doa) and Role access matrix (role-matrix) from all 35 non-administrator profiles, enforced Administration-only tab guards in SecurityGovernanceRegistry and the console UI, updated supervisor and branch/agent/banca supervisor default landing tabs to Overview, and removed non-admin matrix shortcut buttons.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Switch into Administration via the Role Gate whenever inspecting or editing role permissions, supervision chains or DOA matrices. Non-administrator roles continue raising and deciding operational DOA requests through their header notifications and guard banner.

entries.title: Unlocked non-financial partner reconciliation foundation
entries.why: Insurer operations, distribution supervisors and finance desks need configurable channel/sub-channel reference types, human-confirmed identity header mapping and deterministic scoped policy matching now, while keeping unapproved financial commission formulas safely locked.
entries.what: Unlocked reconciliationFeatureGate in non_financial_foundation mode by default (financialCalculationsEnabled: false), added ReconciliationFoundationWorkspace, /api/reconciliation endpoints, and the Partner reconciliation console tab with insurer/partner ownership hierarchy, identity-only header confirmation, exact and insured-corroborated zero-padding matching, duplicate quarantine and auditable human review of tentative proposals.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Open Partner reconciliation to configure insurer channel/sub-channel types, confirm identity-only CSV headers, run scoped partner-versus-insurer policy matching and review tentative proposals. Financial commission, free-look, clawback, payable statement and AP payment calculations remain disabled until business rules are signed off.

entries.title: What's New publication corrected
entries.why: The merged reconciliation foundation was absent because release entries are curated manually and the deployed demo uses a committed snapshot.
entries.what: Added the missing PR #38 entry, rebuilt the static demo, and added checks that detect a stale demo when published entries change. Merged PRs are not imported automatically.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Read the reconciliation entry below. For future releases, maintainers must add an entry and rebuild the demo; filing an entry on this screen is temporary.

entries.title: Partner reconciliation foundation — not yet available
entries.why: Partner commission reconciliation needs insurer- and partner-scoped groundwork before any commission is calculated or paid.
entries.what: Added disabled, non-financial groundwork: ownership metadata and read-only database isolation, guarded migrations, and offline identity-matching and column-mapping helpers. This did not add a reconciliation screen, file uploads, commission calculations, approvals or payment processing.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: No new reconciliation workflow is available to use. Provide the approved free-look, commission and clawback rules; keep the feature disabled and do not use real customer data until the required finance, security, privacy and payment acceptance is complete.

entries.title: Security profiles renamed to roles, four authority tiers, DOA change only at supervisor/manager level, officer limit-increase requests, and a role access matrix with a tab → section → sub-section enable/disable tree
entries.why: The pre-load security layer called each permission template a “profile”, which reads like a person and would collide with the user-account layer that has to come later. It also let any tier change DOA caps and section visibility, so an officer could widen its own authority, and there was no single screen that showed, per role, exactly which tabs, sections and sub-sections are visible and editable.
entries.what: Renamed the concept to role everywhere in the UI, guides and endpoints (the internal SecurityProfile alias and the legacy x-portal-profile header are kept so nothing breaks), added four authority tiers — 22 officer, 4 supervisor, 9 manager, 1 executive — with rank-ordered rules the registry enforces: officers can never change a DOA cap or the access tree, supervisors and managers may only edit lower tiers and never above their own cap, and an officer instead raises a tracked DOA limit-increase request that routes to its mapped supervisor and applies only on approval, never automatically. A new Role access matrix tab sets each role’s tab → section → sub-section tree to full, read-only, hidden or inherit, storing only explicit overrides so inherited levels stay explainable, next to the 36-role directory, the DOA cap editor and the access change audit trail. The access guard banner now shows the active tier and carries the officer request form.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Open Role access matrix, pick the role you want to inspect, and walk the tree tab by tab — inherit means the node follows its parent, and the effective badge shows what will actually be enforced. If you are an officer, use Request a DOA limit increase in the access banner instead of editing a cap; your supervisor receives it in the approver inbox. Named user logins are still a later layer and will reference a role id.

entries.title: Enterprise 36-profile pre-load security gate, AI RBAC & DOA approvals (including Batch processing authority), zero-duplicate auto-pick & configurable Age Nearest/Next/Last setup
entries.why: The platform previously opened straight into full operational menus with no persona security gate, no Delegation-of-Authority (DOA) approval workflow with approver notifications, repeated entry of customer DOB/age/height/weight/dependent products across screens, and fixed age entry without configurable actuarial age rules.
entries.what: Added a pre-load Security Profile Selection Gate covering all 36 enterprise profiles (Administration with complete unrestricted access, Supervisor, Configurator, Underwriting, Retention, Endorsement, Claims, Settlement, Reinsurance, Bancassurance Ops, Fund Config, Accountant, Finance, Cost Controller, Fund Investment, Agents 1/2/Marsh/Supervisor, Banca 1/2/Supervisor, Branch Officer/Manager, Bank Manager, Aggregator, Direct Customer, Referral Partners 1/2), a dedicated Access & DOA tab with AI tab/section/sub-section recommendations + Segregation-of-Duties checks, Entity × Channel × Sub-Channel supervisor mapping with live approver notifications, automatic customer/proposal/dependent-product Auto-Pick memory, editable + suggested SmartComboBox controls, and Master Settings actuarial age configuration (Age Nearest Birthday, Age Next Birthday, Age Last Birthday).
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Select your profile at the pre-load gate (choose Administration for complete unrestricted access), review Entity × Channel × Sub-Channel DOA chains in Access & DOA, and verify your tenant default Age Calculation Basis (ANB / ANxB / ALB) and dependent-product auto-pick rules in Master settings.

entries.title: Live ERP / portal / application theme engine, Batch processing & warehouse offline bundle sync, and PR #10 / PR #11 audit logs
entries.why: Two previous changes (PR #10 — Funds accounting, Super funds, Data warehouse & Brand onboarding; PR #11 — Batch processing, What’s New, Warehouse Snowflake/Excel/Access security & Application theme tab) were missing from the live deployed console and from ledger/runs.jsonl and backlog/status.jsonl because demo/offline.html stayed frozen at PR #8 (4cd7802). In addition, theme changes did not visibly re-skin the application because ThemeRegistry sorted alphabetically by ownerId (always picking ALK-CONV / DXB-BROKER-01 / BROKER), ThemePanel sent default dark hex values over AI-generated palettes, and inputs/tables/grids used hardcoded dark hex colours.
entries.what: Rebuilt demo/offline.html and demo/offline-responses.json and wired the build pipeline so every build keeps the deployed console current across all 26 tabs. Added active-layer tracking (POST /themes/activate), six one-click brand presets (Midnight Slate, Royal Takaful Emerald & Gold, Gulf Sovereign Gold & Navy, DIFC Executive Crimson, Arabian Sea Cyan & Violet, Executive Daylight), full 8-token WCAG-AA AI palette derivation, and CSS variable wiring across inputs, tables, grids and scoped customer/partner surfaces. Backfilled PR #10 and PR #11 in ledger/runs.jsonl, backlog/status.jsonl, docs/06-QA-REPORT.md and the unified module audit log on the AI ledger tab.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Open Application theme, click any one-click brand preset or click Apply / Set active on ALK-TKF (Royal Takaful Emerald & Gold) to watch the entire ERP console re-skin immediately, or test Partner / Omni-channel themes on Customer journey and Underwriting.

entries.title: Batch processing for quotations, issuance and monthly anniversaries
entries.why: Quotation generation, illustration generation, policy issuance and the monthly anniversary charges (mortality, premium accrual, commission accrual and clawback, fund management charges and dividend distribution) were individual actions. Operations needs them as governed, repeatable batches with accounting filed once per event — and a hard stop the moment a policy lapses, is fully withdrawn or is surrendered.
entries.what: A new Batch processing tab holds one event-setup register (debit account, credit account, schedule, basis, rate, applicable statuses) for all nine events, a Run panel per event and period, and run history. Subjects are the live quotations and policies plus any leavers. Terminal subjects are reported as skipped-terminal, never charged; clawback is the one job that targets leavers. Re-running a period is safe — job + period + subject is the idempotency key, and re-runs report duplicate-skipped instead of double-charging.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Open Batch processing, review each event’s debit/credit setup with Finance before the first live run, then run one monthly period and check the voucher references and totals by currency. High-risk (money-moving) runs still need the named human approval your AGENTS.md risk gate requires.

entries.title: What's New — this tab, generated from commits and change requests
entries.why: Changes were only visible in git history, which operators never read. Every implementation and change request deserves a plain-language record: why it exists, what changed, and what the reader must do.
entries.what: A new final tab lists every shipped change newest-first, with category, source (commit/PR/change request), Why / What / What you need to do, the console area to open, and risk. A generator turns future commit subjects and bodies into entries in exactly this shape, so filing a change becomes part of shipping it.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Check this tab after each release. When you ship a change, write the commit body as two paragraphs (why, then what) — it will be drafted into an entry automatically.

entries.title: Snowflake, Excel and Access warehouse connections — validated secrets, breach agreement, rotating PII masking
entries.why: The warehouse could export CSV/JSON and describe BI connectors, but Snowflake, Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Access pipelines need governed connections: a secret that is validated but never displayed, a signed data-breach agreement before any sync, and a guarantee that no real customer information reaches an analyst tool.
entries.what: The Data warehouse tab gains a Connections & PII masking section for Snowflake, Excel and Access. Registering a connection requires the current data-breach agreement (version, signer, date), stores only a SHA-256 fingerprint of the secret (the secret itself is never shown or returned), and runs a step-by-step validation (shape, secret strength, agreement, target) with an expiry. Every sample, export and connection preview is PII-masked with a one-way keyed hash whose method rotates on every transaction — the same customer masks differently in every drop, there is no decode function, and per-transaction salts are never exported.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Have your data-protection owner accept the current breach agreement, put connection secrets in your secret store (never in a ticket), register and validate each Snowflake/Excel/Access connection, and re-point BI tools at masked extracts. Never join two extracts on a masked value — masking rotates per transaction on purpose.

entries.title: Application theme — now a top-level tab
entries.source: PR #11 · commit f8eb9e8 (merged 02806d2) · PR #10 · commit a6468eb
entries.why: Theme onboarding existed — entity, partner and omni-channel brand layers with AI-assisted palettes — but it lived inside Master settings, so brand owners could not find it and reasonably reported it missing.
entries.what: A new Application theme tab brings the three existing panels to the top level: entity theme (applies globally), partner theme and omni-channel theme (both scoped to partner detail, the customer journey and quotation). Upload a logo/header/footer, let the local palette assistant sample dominant colours, review the swatches, generate, preview, enable/disable — and the console shell re-skins immediately. The Master settings sections remain in place.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Open Application theme, upload your entity logo, review the generated palette for contrast, and generate. Partner and channel owners should file their scoped layers there too, then check the Customer journey to see the scoped surface.

entries.title: Data warehouse — nine lineage-bearing datasets for analysts
entries.why: Analysts were screenshotting operational screens. They need one read model with grain, lineage and fingerprinted exports that never becomes a second ledger.
entries.what: Nine datasets (policy, premium, fund NAV, claim, reinsurance, commission schedule, super, voucher lines, member balances) with source, grain, sample rows and lineage; five native dashboard definitions; full CSV/JSON exports with content fingerprints; connector recipes for Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Databricks and Data Fabric.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Use exports from the Data warehouse tab rather than screen copies, and record the fingerprint with anything you publish. External BI sessions still need your deployment credentials — see WN-0005 for governed Snowflake/Excel/Access connections and masking.

entries.title: Funds accounting, super funds and event-based vouchers
entries.why: Accounting treatment differed by country and fund but was implicit. Finance needs the mapping from a policy event to a balanced debit/credit voucher to be filed data, not code.
entries.what: Country accounting standards, fund rules and dynamic mappings (event × product × partner × channel × policy) resolve every event — premium, deposit, accrual, allocation, gain/loss, withdrawal, charge — into a balanced voucher linked to a ledger journal. Super funds add monthly charges and pro-rata income allocation through the same vouchers. The Batch processing tab (WN-0007) now schedules these event types over the whole book.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Finance should review the filed mappings in Funds accounting before relying on batch runs, and check that every batch voucher reference traces to a balanced voucher.

entries.title: The guided customer journey, tenant master settings and the AI guide
entries.why: A sale crossed nineteen screens with no enforced order, and every tenant hardcoded its own country, currency and vocabulary.
entries.what: Nineteen gated journey sections that unlock only at 100% completion, tenant master settings (39 country packs, currencies, field renaming, the 96-product factory, rating tables, omni-channel commission/clawback), and an AI guide note on every section with a filed on/off switch.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Set your country, calendar and currencies in Master settings first — every other screen reads them. Use the guide switch in the header if you want the notes hidden; the change is audited.

whatsNew.howEntriesAreMade: Entries are curated manually; merging a PR does not automatically add one. To publish a lasting entry, update the release seed and rebuild the demo. Entries filed using this screen are temporary and do not survive a restart. You can draft one from a commit subject and body, then file it manually.

{{tenant.name}} · {{department}}

eventCatalogue.label: Information pack
eventCatalogue.description: The information desk sends the product information pack, key facts and the complaints route.
eventCatalogue.defaultBody:
Dear {{customer.name}},

As requested, the information pack for {{policy.product}} is attached. It describes what is covered, what is not, how a claim is made and how to complain.

If anything is unclear, reply to this message and the information desk will answer it.

{{tenant.name}} · {{department}}

eventCatalogue.label: Renewal request
eventCatalogue.description: The retention desk invites renewal, states the date and premium, and asks for any change of circumstances.
eventCatalogue.defaultBody:
Dear {{customer.name}},

Your {{policy.product}} policy {{policy.number}} renews on {{renewal.date}}. The renewal premium is {{renewal.premium}}.

Please tell us before {{due.date}} if your circumstances, cover or beneficiary have changed, so the renewal is based on the right facts.

{{tenant.name}} · {{department}}

eventCatalogue.label: Alteration confirmed
eventCatalogue.description: The alterations desk confirms a policy endorsement and states when it takes effect.
eventCatalogue.defaultBody:
Dear {{customer.name}},

Your requested alteration {{alteration.number}} to policy {{policy.number}} is confirmed and takes effect on {{alteration.effectiveDate}}.

The revised policy schedule is attached. Any premium difference is shown on your next statement.

{{tenant.name}} · {{department}}

eventCatalogue.label: Premium receipt
eventCatalogue.description: The finance desk confirms money received and the amount still outstanding, if any.
eventCatalogue.defaultBody:
Dear {{customer.name}},

We have received {{amount}}. Your receipt reference is {{payment.reference}}.

The payment is allocated to policy {{policy.number}}. If a balance remains, it is due by {{payment.dueDate}}.

{{tenant.name}} · {{department}}

eventCatalogue.label: Claim acknowledgement
eventCatalogue.description: The claims desk confirms a claim was received, names the handler and states when a decision is due.
eventCatalogue.defaultBody:
Dear {{customer.name}},

We received your claim {{claim.number}} on {{claim.receivedDate}}. It is being handled by {{agent.name}}, who can be reached at {{agent.email}}.

We will write to you again by {{due.date}}. Please quote the claim number in any correspondence.

{{tenant.name}} · {{department}}

eventCatalogue.label: Claim settled
eventCatalogue.description: The claims desk states the settlement decision, the amount and how it was paid.
eventCatalogue.defaultBody:
Dear {{customer.name}},

Your claim {{claim.number}} has been settled for {{amount}}. The settlement letter is attached.

The decision is explained in the letter, including how to ask for a review if you disagree with it.

{{tenant.name}} · {{department}}

eventCatalogue.label: Reinsurance placement
eventCatalogue.description: The reinsurance desk notifies the reinsurer of a placement, a cession or a change to a treaty.
eventCatalogue.defaultBody:
Dear {{partner.name}},

This is a notification for treaty {{reinsurance.treaty}} for the period {{reinsurance.period}}.

The placement covers {{policy.product}} with ceded premium of {{amount}}. The placement file and the country regulatory reference are attached.

{{tenant.name}} · {{department}}

eventCatalogue.label: Welcome pack
eventCatalogue.description: The servicing desk introduces the portal, the servicing route and the customer’s access details.
eventCatalogue.defaultBody:
Dear {{customer.name}},

Welcome. Your customer reference is {{customer.reference}} and your policies are available in the portal.

For anything at all, reply to this message and the servicing desk will help.

{{tenant.name}} · {{department}}

eventCatalogue.label: Lapse notice
eventCatalogue.description: The retention desk warns that a policy is about to lapse and what has to happen to keep it in force.
eventCatalogue.defaultBody:
Dear {{customer.name}},

Our records show that {{amount}} remains unpaid on policy {{policy.number}}. If it is not received by {{due.date}}, the policy will lapse and cover will stop.

If the amount is already paid, please reply so we can correct the record.

{{tenant.name}} · {{department}}

eventCatalogue.label: Surrender confirmed
eventCatalogue.description: The servicing desk confirms a surrender and the charge applied, with the statement attached.
eventCatalogue.defaultBody:
Dear {{customer.name}},

The surrender of policy {{policy.number}} is confirmed. The surrender value is {{amount}} and any charge is shown on the attached statement.

The policy is no longer in force from {{alteration.effectiveDate}}.

{{tenant.name}} · {{department}}

eventCatalogue.label: Complaint acknowledgement
eventCatalogue.description: The complaints desk acknowledges a complaint and states the date a final response is due.
eventCatalogue.defaultBody:
Dear {{customer.name}},

We have recorded your complaint and are investigating it. Our reference is {{customer.reference}}.

We will send a final response by {{due.date}}. If we cannot, we will explain why and tell you when to expect it.

{{tenant.name}} · {{department}}

eventCatalogue.label: Fund statement
eventCatalogue.description: The servicing desk sends the periodic statement for a unit-linked or investment policy.
eventCatalogue.defaultBody:
Dear {{customer.name}},

The statement for policy {{policy.number}} is attached. The fund value shown is {{amount}}.

Past performance is not a guide to future returns, and the value of units can go down as well as up.

{{tenant.name}} · {{department}}

roles.name: Administration
roles.title: Chief Platform & Security Administrator (Complete Access)
roles.summary: Complete unrestricted superuser access across every console tab, section and sub-section, Master Settings, RBAC & DOA governance, and unlimited override authority.
roles.aiRationale: Root enterprise administrator: full read/write/approve across every operational, actuarial, financial and governance surface.

roles.name: Supervisor
roles.title: Cross-Operations & Distribution Supervisor
roles.summary: Cross-functional supervision over operational queues, customer journeys, escalations, AI human-in-the-loop reviews and first-line DOA approvals.
roles.aiRationale: Cross-desk queue oversight, human AI review, DOA inbox management, and read-only visibility into technical claims/underwriting.

roles.name: Configurator
roles.title: Product, Rating, Wording & Platform Configurator
roles.summary: Configures product shelf, tariff tables, age calculation rules (ANB/ANxB/ALB), dependent product rules, omni-channels, providers, email templates and branding.
roles.aiRationale: Full control over non-cash configuration surfaces while masking customer PII and blocking direct claim payouts or GL postings (SoD safe).

roles.name: Underwriter Officer
roles.title: Life, Medical & General Risk Underwriter Officer
roles.summary: Evaluates proposals, medical evidence, BMI/occupation loadings and issues standard/rated decisions within officer DOA; refers higher risks to Underwriter Manager.
roles.aiRationale: Full risk scoring, medical questionnaire review and standard binding up to 500k AED; escalates jumbo risks automatically to Underwriter Manager.

roles.name: Underwriter Manager
roles.title: Head of Underwriting & Chief Risk Signatory
roles.summary: Approves high-sum-assured proposals, substandard mortality loadings, medical waivers and agent/banca underwriting referrals up to treaty limits.
roles.aiRationale: Full underwriting authority up to 5M AED across Conventional & Takaful books, plus human sign-off on AI referrals and officer escalations.

roles.name: Retention Officer
roles.title: Policy Conservation & Renewal Retention Officer
roles.summary: Manages policy conservation, renewal outreach, surrender rescue illustrations, fund switches and fee-waiver concessions within retention officer DOA.
roles.aiRationale: Equipped with Decision Theatre switch/withdrawal previews, Policyholder conservation tools and Cover Control, escalating fee waivers >15k AED to Retention Manager.

roles.name: Retention Manager
roles.title: Head of Portfolio Persistency & Retention
roles.summary: Oversees renewal persistency, conservation campaigns, surrender rescue DOA concessions and retention email triggers across all channels.
roles.aiRationale: Approves retention waivers up to 150k AED with full visibility into persistency cohorts, renewal email routes and policyholder look-through.

roles.name: Endorsement Officer
roles.title: Policy Alterations & Endorsement Officer
roles.summary: Processes non-financial changes (address, beneficiary, contact) and financial endorsements (sum assured, riders, payment frequency) within DOA.
roles.aiRationale: Direct access to Policyholder alterations, Customer 360 updates and Cover segments; financial alterations above 50k AED route to Endorsement Supervisor.

roles.name: Endorsement Supervisor
roles.title: Policy Servicing & Endorsement Supervisor
roles.summary: Supervises policy servicing SLAs and approves high-value financial alterations, backdated endorsements and beneficiary overrides.
roles.aiRationale: Approves financial endorsements up to 500k AED and escalates underwriting-impacting increases above 500k AED to Underwriter Manager.

roles.name: Claim Officer
roles.title: Claims FNOL, Triage & Assessment Officer
roles.summary: Registers FNOL claims, verifies cover/exclusions, sets initial technical reserves and approves straightforward claims up to officer DOA.
roles.aiRationale: Segregation of Duties enforced: Claim Officer assesses & approves within 50k AED but cash disbursement belongs to Settlement Desk; >50k AED routes to Claim Manager.

roles.name: Claim Manager
roles.title: Head of Claims Adjudication & Technical Reserves
roles.summary: Adjudicates complex/high-severity Conventional & Takaful claims, signs off reserves, declines invalid claims with rationale and triggers reinsurance recovery.
roles.aiRationale: Full adjudication authority up to 500k AED across Conventional & Takaful pools while preserving four-eyes separation from Settlement cash release.

roles.name: Settlement Officer
roles.title: Claims, Maturity & Surrender Settlement Officer
roles.summary: Verifies discharge vouchers, payee IBAN/KYC and releases approved claim, maturity and surrender settlements up to officer disbursement DOA.
roles.aiRationale: Four-eyes payout control: executes settlement disbursements up to 100k AED on already-adjudicated claims and routes larger releases to Settlement Manager.

roles.name: Settlement Manager
roles.title: Head of Disbursements, Settlements & Subrogation
roles.summary: Authorizes high-value claim payouts, maturity/surrender batch disbursements, salvage/subrogation recoveries and treasury payment releases.
roles.aiRationale: High-value settlement release up to 2M AED with visibility into GL books, batch payment runs and reinsurance recoveries.

roles.name: Reinsurance Officer
roles.title: Treaty Administration, Cession & Facultative Officer
roles.summary: Administers quota-share/surplus/XOL cessions, retakaful treaties, facultative placements, cash calls and LOC security tracking within officer DOA.
roles.aiRationale: Full access to treaty bordereaux, facultative placement prep and collateral monitoring up to 1M AED; routes treaty changes & >1M placements to Reinsurance Manager.

roles.name: Reinsurance Manager
roles.title: Head of Reinsurance, Retakaful & Counterparty Security
roles.summary: Approves treaty structures, net retention limits, jumbo facultative bindings, catastrophe reinstatements, cash calls and regulatory reinsurance filings.
roles.aiRationale: Authorizes ceded placements & security releases up to 10M AED with full UAE reinsurance rule-book and statutory return access.

roles.name: Bancassurance Operations Officer
roles.title: Bancassurance Middle-Office & Bank Feed Operations Officer
roles.summary: Reconciles daily bank feed files, clears quarantined rows, supports bank policy issuance, bank direct-debit batch runs and branch servicing requests.
roles.aiRationale: Tailored for bank middle-office operations: Ingestion feed reconciliation, KYC queue, Policy issuance & Batch sweeps, reporting to Banca Supervisor.

roles.name: Fund Configuration
roles.title: Unit-Linked & Superannuation Fund Configuration Specialist
roles.summary: Configures unit-linked funds, Super investment products, dealing cut-offs, FMC basis points, Shariah screening flags and fund-to-product mappings.
roles.aiRationale: Focused control over Funds, Super Funds and Fund Accounting rules while escalating live fee or valuation sign-offs >250k AED to Fund Investment Manager.

roles.name: Accountant
roles.title: Financial & Policy Ledger Accountant
roles.summary: Maintains chart of accounts mappings, posts balanced vouchers, verifies trial balances, runs monthly accounting batches and prepares statutory extracts.
roles.aiRationale: Full access to double-entry Books, Funds Accounting vouchers and scheduled Batch postings within 100k AED; >100k AED routes to Finance.

roles.name: Finance
roles.title: Head of Finance, Group Consolidation & Treasury
roles.summary: Governs multi-entity IFRS/local consolidation, FX translation reserves, intercompany eliminations, treasury releases, statutory filings and accounting approvals.
roles.aiRationale: Full group finance, ledger proof, voucher approval up to 2.5M AED and cryptographic durability verification.

roles.name: Cost Controller
roles.title: Acquisition Cost, Commission, Fee & AI Spend Controller
roles.summary: Controls partner/channel commission schedules, clawback rules, policy admin/allocation charges, expense budgets and AI token/agent spend governance.
roles.aiRationale: Pinpoint visibility into commission schedules, charge tables, clawback batches, warehouse cost lineage and AI spend telemetry.

roles.name: Fund Investment Officer
roles.title: Portfolio Valuation, NAV Pricing & Dealing Officer
roles.summary: Records daily market instrument prices, runs unit-linked NAV calculations, checks Shariah asset screens and executes member dealing allocations.
roles.aiRationale: Operational NAV valuation, look-through pricing and Super investment runs up to 500k AED; escalates seed/rebalance sign-off to Fund Investment Manager.

roles.name: Fund Investment Manager
roles.title: Chief Investment Officer & Fund Governance Approver
roles.summary: Approves daily NAV publication exceptions, Super fund income/loss distributions, Shariah portfolio purification actions and fund launches up to 10M AED.
roles.aiRationale: Full investment governance across Unit-Linked, Takaful PIF and Superannuation portfolios with 10M AED DOA authority.

roles.name: Agent 1
roles.title: Tied Life & Wealth Advisor — Agency Desk 1 (Conventional)
roles.summary: Conducts customer onboarding, fact-find needs analysis, suitability recommendations, benefit illustrations, quotations and proposal submissions on Agency Desk 1.
roles.aiRationale: Frontline sales productivity on Agency Desk 1 without underwriting self-approval; quotes >250k AED or fee concessions notify Agent Supervisor immediately.

roles.name: Agent 2
roles.title: Family Takaful & Protection Advisor — Agency Desk 2
roles.summary: Advises Conventional & Family Takaful clients on Agency Desk 2 across customer onboarding, Shariah-screened fund illustrations and policy applications.
roles.aiRationale: Scoped to Agency Desk 2 with Takaful pool read visibility for transparent Wakalah/Tabarru client disclosures; supervised by Agent Supervisor.

roles.name: Agent Marsh
roles.title: Marsh Multinational Broker Producer (UAE / UK / Singapore Shelf)
roles.summary: Places multinational corporate & high-net-worth risks under licensed Marsh Call-Centre and Marsh Agency sub-channels with country/currency sellability enforcement.
roles.aiRationale: Aligned with the Marsh multi-country broker setup (Conventional allowed on MARSH-AGENCY; both books on MARSH-CALL-CENTRE) with 1M AED broker quote threshold.

roles.name: Agent Supervisor
roles.title: Agency & Broker Distribution Supervisor (Approver)
roles.summary: Supervises Agent 1, Agent 2 and Agent Marsh across Agency & Broker channels; approves commission concessions, large quotes and rider waivers up to 1.5M AED.
roles.aiRationale: First-line DOA approver for all Agency & Marsh broker producers up to 1.5M AED, escalating technical risk decisions above cap to Underwriter Manager.

roles.name: Banca Officer 1
roles.title: Bancassurance Wealth Specialist — Premier Bank Desk 1
roles.summary: Originates unit-linked wealth, mortgage protection and endowment plans for premier bank customers on Bancassurance Desk 1.
roles.aiRationale: Scoped to BANCA-PREMIER-1 with customer auto-pick, fund look-through visibility and 300k AED straight-through quote cap; reports to Banca Supervisor.

roles.name: Banca Officer 2
roles.title: Bancatakaful & Retail Protection Specialist — Islamic Bank Desk 2
roles.summary: Originates Family Takaful savings, credit takaful and retail protection plans on Bancassurance Islamic Desk 2.
roles.aiRationale: Scoped to BANCA-ISLAMIC-2 with Shariah fund & Takaful pool visibility; routes >300k AED cases automatically to Banca Supervisor.

roles.name: Banca Supervisor
roles.title: Bancassurance Channel Supervisor (Approver)
roles.summary: Supervises Banca Officer 1, Banca Officer 2 and Bancassurance Operations across bank sub-channels; approves banca quotes & concessions up to 1.5M AED.
roles.aiRationale: Supervises all bancassurance specialists and feed operations up to 1.5M AED, escalating larger private-bank cases to Bank Manager.

roles.name: Branch Officer
roles.title: Retail Bank Branch Insurance Officer
roles.summary: Handles walk-in retail bank customer KYC capture, auto-picked needs check, simple protection/motor quotes and branch referrals.
roles.aiRationale: Streamlined branch desk footprint with 150k AED walk-in DOA; cases above 150k AED notify Branch Manager immediately.

roles.name: Branch Manager
roles.title: Bank Branch Manager — BranchBancassurance Approver
roles.summary: Manages branch insurance production, supervises Branch Officers, reviews customer suitability sign-offs and approves branch exceptions up to 750k AED.
roles.aiRationale: Approves retail branch referrals up to 750k AED and escalates HNW/corporate bank cases cleanly to Bank Manager.

roles.name: Bank Manager
roles.title: Executive Head of Partner Bank & Multi-Branch Network
roles.summary: Executive authority across all bank branches and bancassurance sub-channels; approves HNW/private-banking cases up to 5M AED and monitors bank-wide KPIs.
roles.aiRationale: Top distribution governance across the entire bank partnership up to 5M AED with full warehouse analytics and multi-branch supervision.

roles.name: Aggregator
roles.title: Digital Comparison & API Aggregator Partner
roles.summary: Generates instant comparative quotes, pre-sale regulatory compliance checks and straight-through digital submissions within aggregator shelf limits.
roles.aiRationale: Strictly isolated digital aggregator surface: instant quoting, comparison matrix and micro-cover without back-office ledger or cross-customer PII access.

roles.name: Direct Customer
roles.title: Self-Service Policyholder & Direct Digital Customer
roles.summary: Self-service customer portal: complete personal digital purchase journey, inspect own unit-linked look-through, toggle micro-cover and request alterations/claims.
roles.aiRationale: Own-policy isolation only: zero visibility into back-office queues, other parties, books or master configuration; service changes route to Endorsement Officer.

roles.name: Referral Partner 1
roles.title: Wealth & Family Office Introducer — Referral Partner 1
roles.summary: Captures consented client introductions, runs initial needs & indicative illustrations and hands qualified leads to licensed Agency/Advisory desks.
roles.aiRationale: Regulatory introducer perimeter: permitted to onboard KYC leads and generate indicative illustrations only; binding & payment hand off to licensed advisors.

roles.name: Referral Partner 2
roles.title: Corporate & Affinity Introducer — Referral Partner 2
roles.summary: Submits affinity/corporate employee leads and Takaful/Conventional indicative benefit illustrations under Referral Sub-Channel 2.
roles.aiRationale: Scoped to REF-AFFINITY-02 with indicative Takaful/Conventional illustration access; policy binding strictly gated behind licensed supervisor approval.

profiles.summary: Reconciles daily bank feed files, clears quarantined rows, supports bank policy issuance, bank direct-debit batch runs and branch servicing requests.
profiles.aiRationale: Tailored for bank middle-office operations: Ingestion feed reconciliation, KYC queue, Policy issuance & Batch sweeps, reporting to Banca Supervisor.

profiles.name: Fund Configuration
profiles.title: Unit-Linked & Superannuation Fund Configuration Specialist
profiles.summary: Configures unit-linked funds, Super investment products, dealing cut-offs, FMC basis points, Shariah screening flags and fund-to-product mappings.
profiles.aiRationale: Focused control over Funds, Super Funds and Fund Accounting rules while escalating live fee or valuation sign-offs >250k AED to Fund Investment Manager.

profiles.name: Accountant
profiles.title: Financial & Policy Ledger Accountant
profiles.summary: Maintains chart of accounts mappings, posts balanced vouchers, verifies trial balances, runs monthly accounting batches and prepares statutory extracts.
profiles.aiRationale: Full access to double-entry Books, Funds Accounting vouchers and scheduled Batch postings within 100k AED; >100k AED routes to Finance.

profiles.name: Finance
profiles.title: Head of Finance, Group Consolidation & Treasury
profiles.summary: Governs multi-entity IFRS/local consolidation, FX translation reserves, intercompany eliminations, treasury releases, statutory filings and accounting approvals.
profiles.aiRationale: Full group finance, ledger proof, voucher approval up to 2.5M AED and cryptographic durability verification.

profiles.name: Cost Controller
profiles.title: Acquisition Cost, Commission, Fee & AI Spend Controller
profiles.summary: Controls partner/channel commission schedules, clawback rules, policy admin/allocation charges, expense budgets and AI token/agent spend governance.
profiles.aiRationale: Pinpoint visibility into commission schedules, charge tables, clawback batches, warehouse cost lineage and AI spend telemetry.

profiles.name: Fund Investment Officer
profiles.title: Portfolio Valuation, NAV Pricing & Dealing Officer
profiles.summary: Records daily market instrument prices, runs unit-linked NAV calculations, checks Shariah asset screens and executes member dealing allocations.
profiles.aiRationale: Operational NAV valuation, look-through pricing and Super investment runs up to 500k AED; escalates seed/rebalance sign-off to Fund Investment Manager.

profiles.name: Fund Investment Manager
profiles.title: Chief Investment Officer & Fund Governance Approver
profiles.summary: Approves daily NAV publication exceptions, Super fund income/loss distributions, Shariah portfolio purification actions and fund launches up to 10M AED.
profiles.aiRationale: Full investment governance across Unit-Linked, Takaful PIF and Superannuation portfolios with 10M AED DOA authority.

profiles.name: Agent 1
profiles.title: Tied Life & Wealth Advisor — Agency Desk 1 (Conventional)
profiles.summary: Conducts customer onboarding, fact-find needs analysis, suitability recommendations, benefit illustrations, quotations and proposal submissions on Agency Desk 1.
profiles.aiRationale: Frontline sales productivity on Agency Desk 1 without underwriting self-approval; quotes >250k AED or fee concessions notify Agent Supervisor immediately.

profiles.name: Agent 2
profiles.title: Family Takaful & Protection Advisor — Agency Desk 2
profiles.summary: Advises Conventional & Family Takaful clients on Agency Desk 2 across customer onboarding, Shariah-screened fund illustrations and policy applications.
profiles.aiRationale: Scoped to Agency Desk 2 with Takaful pool read visibility for transparent Wakalah/Tabarru client disclosures; supervised by Agent Supervisor.

profiles.name: Agent Marsh
profiles.title: Marsh Multinational Broker Producer (UAE / UK / Singapore Shelf)
profiles.summary: Places multinational corporate & high-net-worth risks under licensed Marsh Call-Centre and Marsh Agency sub-channels with country/currency sellability enforcement.
profiles.aiRationale: Aligned with the Marsh multi-country broker setup (Conventional allowed on MARSH-AGENCY; both books on MARSH-CALL-CENTRE) with 1M AED broker quote threshold.

profiles.name: Agent Supervisor
profiles.title: Agency & Broker Distribution Supervisor (Approver)
profiles.summary: Supervises Agent 1, Agent 2 and Agent Marsh across Agency & Broker channels; approves commission concessions, large quotes and rider waivers up to 1.5M AED.
profiles.aiRationale: First-line DOA approver for all Agency & Marsh broker producers up to 1.5M AED, escalating technical risk decisions above cap to Underwriter Manager.

profiles.name: Banca Officer 1
profiles.title: Bancassurance Wealth Specialist — Premier Bank Desk 1
profiles.summary: Originates unit-linked wealth, mortgage protection and endowment plans for premier bank customers on Bancassurance Desk 1.
profiles.aiRationale: Scoped to BANCA-PREMIER-1 with customer auto-pick, fund look-through visibility and 300k AED straight-through quote cap; reports to Banca Supervisor.

profiles.name: Banca Officer 2
profiles.title: Bancatakaful & Retail Protection Specialist — Islamic Bank Desk 2
profiles.summary: Originates Family Takaful savings, credit takaful and retail protection plans on Bancassurance Islamic Desk 2.
profiles.aiRationale: Scoped to BANCA-ISLAMIC-2 with Shariah fund & Takaful pool visibility; routes >300k AED cases automatically to Banca Supervisor.

profiles.name: Banca Supervisor
profiles.title: Bancassurance Channel Supervisor (Approver)
profiles.summary: Supervises Banca Officer 1, Banca Officer 2 and Bancassurance Operations across bank sub-channels; approves banca quotes & concessions up to 1.5M AED.
profiles.aiRationale: Supervises all bancassurance specialists and feed operations up to 1.5M AED, escalating larger private-bank cases to Bank Manager.

profiles.name: Branch Officer
profiles.title: Retail Bank Branch Insurance Officer
profiles.summary: Handles walk-in retail bank customer KYC capture, auto-picked needs check, simple protection/motor quotes and branch referrals.
profiles.aiRationale: Streamlined branch desk footprint with 150k AED walk-in DOA; cases above 150k AED notify Branch Manager immediately.

profiles.name: Branch Manager
profiles.title: Bank Branch Manager — BranchBancassurance Approver
profiles.summary: Manages branch insurance production, supervises Branch Officers, reviews customer suitability sign-offs and approves branch exceptions up to 750k AED.
profiles.aiRationale: Approves retail branch referrals up to 750k AED and escalates HNW/corporate bank cases cleanly to Bank Manager.

profiles.name: Bank Manager
profiles.title: Executive Head of Partner Bank & Multi-Branch Network
profiles.summary: Executive authority across all bank branches and bancassurance sub-channels; approves HNW/private-banking cases up to 5M AED and monitors bank-wide KPIs.
profiles.aiRationale: Top distribution governance across the entire bank partnership up to 5M AED with full warehouse analytics and multi-branch supervision.

profiles.name: Aggregator
profiles.title: Digital Comparison & API Aggregator Partner
profiles.summary: Generates instant comparative quotes, pre-sale regulatory compliance checks and straight-through digital submissions within aggregator shelf limits.
profiles.aiRationale: Strictly isolated digital aggregator surface: instant quoting, comparison matrix and micro-cover without back-office ledger or cross-customer PII access.

profiles.name: Direct Customer
profiles.title: Self-Service Policyholder & Direct Digital Customer
profiles.summary: Self-service customer portal: complete personal digital purchase journey, inspect own unit-linked look-through, toggle micro-cover and request alterations/claims.
profiles.aiRationale: Own-policy isolation only: zero visibility into back-office queues, other parties, books or master configuration; service changes route to Endorsement Officer.

profiles.name: Referral Partner 1
profiles.title: Wealth & Family Office Introducer — Referral Partner 1
profiles.summary: Captures consented client introductions, runs initial needs & indicative illustrations and hands qualified leads to licensed Agency/Advisory desks.
profiles.aiRationale: Regulatory introducer perimeter: permitted to onboard KYC leads and generate indicative illustrations only; binding & payment hand off to licensed advisors.

profiles.name: Referral Partner 2
profiles.title: Corporate & Affinity Introducer — Referral Partner 2
profiles.summary: Submits affinity/corporate employee leads and Takaful/Conventional indicative benefit illustrations under Referral Sub-Channel 2.
profiles.aiRationale: Scoped to REF-AFFINITY-02 with indicative Takaful/Conventional illustration access; policy binding strictly gated behind licensed supervisor approval.

blocking.detail: no rating for Gulf Reinsurance PSC is on file
blocking.clause: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
blocking.requirement: A reinsurance counterparty should hold a financial strength rating of BBB (S&P) or equivalent — Baa2 or better — or, if it does not, the placement needs documented board-level due diligence before it is bound.
blocking.requirementAr: يُشترط في شركة إعادة التأمين الحصول على تصنيف مالي لا يقل عن BBB أو ما يعادله، وإلا وجب توثيق العناية الواجبة على مستوى مجلس الإدارة.

findings.title: Reinsure only with a company licensed to carry the class
findings.detail: Gulf Reinsurance PSC holds a all licence in its home state
findings.clause: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
findings.requirement: The counterparty must be licensed for the class of business ceded — a UAE licence, or a home-state licence naming the class for a reinsurer abroad. A UAE carrier may reinsure inside or outside the State, but never with an unlicensed company.
findings.requirementAr: لا يجوز للشركة أن تعيد التأمين لدى شركة أخرى ما لم تكن تلك الشركة مرخصة لمزاولة نوع التأمين المطلوب إعادة تأمينه.

findings.title: A counterparty at or above the rating floor, or board diligence on file
findings.detail: no rating for Gulf Reinsurance PSC is on file
findings.clause: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
findings.requirement: A reinsurance counterparty should hold a financial strength rating of BBB (S&P) or equivalent — Baa2 or better — or, if it does not, the placement needs documented board-level due diligence before it is bound.
findings.requirementAr: يُشترط في شركة إعادة التأمين الحصول على تصنيف مالي لا يقل عن BBB أو ما يعادله، وإلا وجب توثيق العناية الواجبة على مستوى مجلس الإدارة.

findings.title: Recoverables count as admissible assets only at or above the floor
findings.detail: the recoverable from Gulf Reinsurance PSC cannot be given credit until its rating is on file
findings.clause: Minimum capital requirement — CBUAE financial regulations — capital, assets and technical provisions
findings.requirement: Money due from a counterparty below the floor is not an admissible asset: the return must show the recoverable without credit for it, and the solvency position must be read with that in mind.
findings.requirementAr: لا تُعد المبالغ المستحقة من معيد تأمين دون التصنيف المطلوب أصولاً مقبولة، ويجب بيانها دون احتساب رصيد لها.

findings.title: Every cession sits inside the board-approved retention and reinsurance plan
findings.detail: the plan was reviewed on 2026-02-10, 7 month(s) before this placement
findings.clause: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
findings.requirement: A cession must be permitted by the plan the board approved, and the plan must have been reviewed inside the year before the placement. A cession outside the plan is refused; a plan whose review window has passed is escalated.
findings.requirementAr: يجب أن تكون إعادة التأمين ضمن الخطة المعتمدة من مجلس الإدارة، وأن تُراجع الخطة سنوياً خلال الأشهر الثلاثة السابقة لكل سنة.

findings.title: UAE risk insured at home, protected anywhere
findings.detail: the risk is retained by a licensed UAE carrier and the reinsurance is placed with Gulf Reinsurance PSC (FAC-MOTOR)
findings.clause: Article (82) — Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 on the Central Bank, the Regulation of Financial Institutions and Activities, and Insurance Business
findings.requirement: The risk stays with a licensed UAE carrier and the reinsurance may be placed anywhere — the decision records which of the two this placement is.
findings.requirementAr: يجوز لشركة التأمين في الدولة إعادة تأمين أعمالها لدى معيدي تأمين داخل الدولة أو خارجها، دون جواز إبرام وثيقة لدى شركة خارج الدولة لتغطية أموال أو ممتلكات داخل الدولة.

body.limitation: The registers are sealed into a canonical, checksummed snapshot with a migration path and replayed into a fresh world on restore; the outbox proves nothing was dropped between snapshots; every record remembers how far the books had got when it was made and is re-proved against the books of its own moment; and the registers carry the actions they took, so a restart puts them back by taking those actions again, checked journal for journal. Two limits are stated rather than papered over: it is not yet a database (no transactional write, no concurrent-reader isolation, no incremental streaming of the outbox), and an action that posts no journal — a cash call, a free reinstatement — is anchored by the number of journals the books held when it happened, which places it in the right window but cannot order two such actions that land inside the same journal.

blocks.en: Files the period’s return, names its schedules and controls, and states every difference accepted and by whom.
blocks.ar: يودع إقرار الفترة، ويحدد جداوله وضوابطه، ويبيّن كل فرق تم قبوله ومن قبله.

blocks.en: Al Khaleej Insurance (conventional), in respect of Emirates Re, for the period 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-05.
blocks.ar: Al Khaleej Insurance (conventional)، بخصوص Emirates Re، عن الفترة 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-05.

blocks.en: Every figure in this document is derived from the cession register and the books of the entity named above; each control that supports it names the ledger account it ties to.
blocks.ar: كل رقم في هذا المستند مستخرج من سجل التنازلات ودفاتر الجهة المذكورة أعلاه؛ وكل ضابط يدعمه يحدد حساب الدفاتر الذي يطابقه.

blocks.en: The return states paid and reserved facts and where its arithmetic stops: no IBNR, no discounting and no unexpired premium on annual business.
blocks.ar: يبيّن الإقرار الوقائع المدفوعة والمحتسبة ونقطة توقف حساباته: لا احتياطي للخسائر المتكبدة ولم تُبلغ، ولا خصم، ولا أقساط غير مكتسبة على الأعمال السنوية.

blocks.en: The risk is carried by a company licensed in the United Arab Emirates and reinsured inside or outside the State; where a counterparty is licensed in a financial free zone it may write reinsurance outside the zone and no other insurance activity.
blocks.ar: يحمل الخطر شركة مرخصة في دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة ويُعاد تأمينه داخل الدولة أو خارجها؛ وإذا كان الطرف المرخص له في منطقة مالية حرة فلا يجوز له مزاولة أي نشاط تأميني خارج المنطقة باستثناء إعادة التأمين.
blocks.instrument: Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023, Articles (42) and (64)

blocks.en: The return is filed on the basis stated above; a corrected return supersedes this one and says what changed.
blocks.ar: يُقدَّم الإقرار على الأساس المبين أعلاه؛ ويحل أي إقرار مصحح محل هذا الإقرار مع بيان ما تغيّر.

riders.name: Critical illness cover
riders.note: Pays a lump sum on first diagnosis of a listed condition; loading follows the base mortality.

riders.name: Accidental death benefit
riders.note: Additional sum assured where death is accidental.

riders.name: Waiver of premium on disability
riders.note: Premiums waived after the deferred period if the life assured is totally disabled.

riders.name: Income protection
requiresEvidence: Proof of income for the last 12 months
riders.note: Monthly benefit replacing a proportion of earned income; occupation class drives the rate.

riders.name: Inpatient medical top-up
riders.note: Priced inside the medical rate table, so it carries no extra mortality loading.

riders.name: Payor benefit (juvenile plans)
riders.note: Waives the premium on the juvenile plan if the paying adult dies or is disabled.

riders.name: Education savings rider
riders.note: Directs part of the contribution to an education fund; no mortality loading.

riders.name: Final expense benefit
riders.note: A fixed benefit for funeral and immediate costs, payable on production of the death certificate.

questionnaire.label: Country of residence
questionnaire.why: Determines which regulatory pack governs the sale and whether an exception approval is needed.

questionnaire.label: How many people depend on your income?
questionnaire.why: Drives how many years of income the cover has to replace.

questionnaire.label: Gross annual income
questionnaire.why: Sets the affordability ceiling and the financial-underwriting cap on sum assured.

questionnaire.label: Sum assured already in force elsewhere
questionnaire.why: Existing cover is deducted from the need — recommending it again is mis-selling.

questionnaire.label: Outstanding mortgage or other debt to cover
questionnaire.why: Debt cover is a separate component of the protection need.

questionnaire.label: What can you afford to pay each year?
questionnaire.why: A recommendation the customer cannot pay is not a recommendation.

questionnaire.label: Main objective for this cover
questionnaire.why: The objective, not the product, is what the recommendation has to answer.

questionnaire.label: Investment risk appetite
questionnaire.why: Decides whether an investment-linked product may be recommended at all.

questionnaire.label: Shariah-compliant arrangement preferred
questionnaire.why: A takaful window may only be recommended to a customer who has asked for it or been offered it explicitly.

questionnaire.label: Your age
questionnaire.why: Entry-age limits, and the term the cover can actually run to.

questionnaire.label: Do you smoke?
questionnaire.why: Feeds the medical questionnaire and the loading that follows it.

questionnaire.label: Any diagnosed medical conditions?
questionnaire.why: A "yes" opens the medical requirements stage; it must never be skipped to speed up a sale.

questionnaire.label: Occupation class
questionnaire.why: Occupational loading is applied before the quotation is generated.

body.questionnaireAttestation: I confirm the answers above are complete and true, and that this needs analysis was carried out before any product was recommended to me.

paymentMethods.label: Cash at the counter
paymentMethods.note: Counted and receipted at the branch; above the counter limit the payment must be banked, not taken in cash.

paymentMethods.label: Credit card (Visa, Mastercard)
paymentMethods.note: Strong customer authentication required; the merchant fee is borne by the insurer, never added to the customer premium.

paymentMethods.label: Debit card (Visa, Mastercard)
paymentMethods.note: Funds leave the customer account immediately; settlement to the insurer follows the card scheme cycle.

paymentMethods.label: Bank transfer (IBAN)
paymentMethods.note: Captured as pending until the bank statement confirms the credit; the payment reference must match the quotation.

paymentMethods.label: Buy now, pay later
paymentMethods.note: The provider pays the insurer and collects instalments from the customer; the provider fee is a cost of sale and must be disclosed. Not offered on a Shariah-compliant arrangement unless the provider is itself approved.

paymentMethods.label: Deposit in branch / cheque
paymentMethods.note: A deposit slip or cheque is held against the quotation until it clears; a cheque that bounces reverses the receipt.

body.rule: Every event needs a filed debit/credit setup before it can run. A quotation or policy is processed only while alive: lapse, full withdrawal, surrender, maturity, claim-out, expired or declined stops all later batches (reported as skipped-terminal). Clawback is the exception — it targets leavers to recover commission. Re-running a period is safe: job + period + subject is the idempotency key.

entries.title: Access & DOA and Role access matrix tabs restricted to Administration only
entries.why: Role governance, Tab → Section → Sub-Section permission trees and DOA matrix administration belong exclusively to the executive Administration profile and should not appear in operational, supervisor, manager, broker, bancassurance or partner workspaces.
entries.what: Deleted Access & DOA (access-doa) and Role access matrix (role-matrix) from all 35 non-administrator profiles, enforced Administration-only tab guards in SecurityGovernanceRegistry and the console UI, updated supervisor and branch/agent/banca supervisor default landing tabs to Overview, and removed non-admin matrix shortcut buttons.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Switch into Administration via the Role Gate whenever inspecting or editing role permissions, supervision chains or DOA matrices. Non-administrator roles continue raising and deciding operational DOA requests through their header notifications and guard banner.

entries.title: Unlocked non-financial partner reconciliation foundation
entries.why: Insurer operations, distribution supervisors and finance desks need configurable channel/sub-channel reference types, human-confirmed identity header mapping and deterministic scoped policy matching now, while keeping unapproved financial commission formulas safely locked.
entries.what: Unlocked reconciliationFeatureGate in non_financial_foundation mode by default (financialCalculationsEnabled: false), added ReconciliationFoundationWorkspace, /api/reconciliation endpoints, and the Partner reconciliation console tab with insurer/partner ownership hierarchy, identity-only header confirmation, exact and insured-corroborated zero-padding matching, duplicate quarantine and auditable human review of tentative proposals.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Open Partner reconciliation to configure insurer channel/sub-channel types, confirm identity-only CSV headers, run scoped partner-versus-insurer policy matching and review tentative proposals. Financial commission, free-look, clawback, payable statement and AP payment calculations remain disabled until business rules are signed off.

entries.title: What's New publication corrected
entries.why: The merged reconciliation foundation was absent because release entries are curated manually and the deployed demo uses a committed snapshot.
entries.what: Added the missing PR #38 entry, rebuilt the static demo, and added checks that detect a stale demo when published entries change. Merged PRs are not imported automatically.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Read the reconciliation entry below. For future releases, maintainers must add an entry and rebuild the demo; filing an entry on this screen is temporary.

entries.title: Partner reconciliation foundation — not yet available
entries.why: Partner commission reconciliation needs insurer- and partner-scoped groundwork before any commission is calculated or paid.
entries.what: Added disabled, non-financial groundwork: ownership metadata and read-only database isolation, guarded migrations, and offline identity-matching and column-mapping helpers. This did not add a reconciliation screen, file uploads, commission calculations, approvals or payment processing.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: No new reconciliation workflow is available to use. Provide the approved free-look, commission and clawback rules; keep the feature disabled and do not use real customer data until the required finance, security, privacy and payment acceptance is complete.

entries.title: Security profiles renamed to roles, four authority tiers, DOA change only at supervisor/manager level, officer limit-increase requests, and a role access matrix with a tab → section → sub-section enable/disable tree
entries.why: The pre-load security layer called each permission template a “profile”, which reads like a person and would collide with the user-account layer that has to come later. It also let any tier change DOA caps and section visibility, so an officer could widen its own authority, and there was no single screen that showed, per role, exactly which tabs, sections and sub-sections are visible and editable.
entries.what: Renamed the concept to role everywhere in the UI, guides and endpoints (the internal SecurityProfile alias and the legacy x-portal-profile header are kept so nothing breaks), added four authority tiers — 22 officer, 4 supervisor, 9 manager, 1 executive — with rank-ordered rules the registry enforces: officers can never change a DOA cap or the access tree, supervisors and managers may only edit lower tiers and never above their own cap, and an officer instead raises a tracked DOA limit-increase request that routes to its mapped supervisor and applies only on approval, never automatically. A new Role access matrix tab sets each role’s tab → section → sub-section tree to full, read-only, hidden or inherit, storing only explicit overrides so inherited levels stay explainable, next to the 36-role directory, the DOA cap editor and the access change audit trail. The access guard banner now shows the active tier and carries the officer request form.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Open Role access matrix, pick the role you want to inspect, and walk the tree tab by tab — inherit means the node follows its parent, and the effective badge shows what will actually be enforced. If you are an officer, use Request a DOA limit increase in the access banner instead of editing a cap; your supervisor receives it in the approver inbox. Named user logins are still a later layer and will reference a role id.

entries.title: Enterprise 36-profile pre-load security gate, AI RBAC & DOA approvals (including Batch processing authority), zero-duplicate auto-pick & configurable Age Nearest/Next/Last setup
entries.why: The platform previously opened straight into full operational menus with no persona security gate, no Delegation-of-Authority (DOA) approval workflow with approver notifications, repeated entry of customer DOB/age/height/weight/dependent products across screens, and fixed age entry without configurable actuarial age rules.
entries.what: Added a pre-load Security Profile Selection Gate covering all 36 enterprise profiles (Administration with complete unrestricted access, Supervisor, Configurator, Underwriting, Retention, Endorsement, Claims, Settlement, Reinsurance, Bancassurance Ops, Fund Config, Accountant, Finance, Cost Controller, Fund Investment, Agents 1/2/Marsh/Supervisor, Banca 1/2/Supervisor, Branch Officer/Manager, Bank Manager, Aggregator, Direct Customer, Referral Partners 1/2), a dedicated Access & DOA tab with AI tab/section/sub-section recommendations + Segregation-of-Duties checks, Entity × Channel × Sub-Channel supervisor mapping with live approver notifications, automatic customer/proposal/dependent-product Auto-Pick memory, editable + suggested SmartComboBox controls, and Master Settings actuarial age configuration (Age Nearest Birthday, Age Next Birthday, Age Last Birthday).
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Select your profile at the pre-load gate (choose Administration for complete unrestricted access), review Entity × Channel × Sub-Channel DOA chains in Access & DOA, and verify your tenant default Age Calculation Basis (ANB / ANxB / ALB) and dependent-product auto-pick rules in Master settings.

entries.title: Live ERP / portal / application theme engine, Batch processing & warehouse offline bundle sync, and PR #10 / PR #11 audit logs
entries.why: Two previous changes (PR #10 — Funds accounting, Super funds, Data warehouse & Brand onboarding; PR #11 — Batch processing, What’s New, Warehouse Snowflake/Excel/Access security & Application theme tab) were missing from the live deployed console and from ledger/runs.jsonl and backlog/status.jsonl because demo/offline.html stayed frozen at PR #8 (4cd7802). In addition, theme changes did not visibly re-skin the application because ThemeRegistry sorted alphabetically by ownerId (always picking ALK-CONV / DXB-BROKER-01 / BROKER), ThemePanel sent default dark hex values over AI-generated palettes, and inputs/tables/grids used hardcoded dark hex colours.
entries.what: Rebuilt demo/offline.html and demo/offline-responses.json and wired the build pipeline so every build keeps the deployed console current across all 26 tabs. Added active-layer tracking (POST /themes/activate), six one-click brand presets (Midnight Slate, Royal Takaful Emerald & Gold, Gulf Sovereign Gold & Navy, DIFC Executive Crimson, Arabian Sea Cyan & Violet, Executive Daylight), full 8-token WCAG-AA AI palette derivation, and CSS variable wiring across inputs, tables, grids and scoped customer/partner surfaces. Backfilled PR #10 and PR #11 in ledger/runs.jsonl, backlog/status.jsonl, docs/06-QA-REPORT.md and the unified module audit log on the AI ledger tab.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Open Application theme, click any one-click brand preset or click Apply / Set active on ALK-TKF (Royal Takaful Emerald & Gold) to watch the entire ERP console re-skin immediately, or test Partner / Omni-channel themes on Customer journey and Underwriting.

entries.title: Batch processing for quotations, issuance and monthly anniversaries
entries.why: Quotation generation, illustration generation, policy issuance and the monthly anniversary charges (mortality, premium accrual, commission accrual and clawback, fund management charges and dividend distribution) were individual actions. Operations needs them as governed, repeatable batches with accounting filed once per event — and a hard stop the moment a policy lapses, is fully withdrawn or is surrendered.
entries.what: A new Batch processing tab holds one event-setup register (debit account, credit account, schedule, basis, rate, applicable statuses) for all nine events, a Run panel per event and period, and run history. Subjects are the live quotations and policies plus any leavers. Terminal subjects are reported as skipped-terminal, never charged; clawback is the one job that targets leavers. Re-running a period is safe — job + period + subject is the idempotency key, and re-runs report duplicate-skipped instead of double-charging.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Open Batch processing, review each event’s debit/credit setup with Finance before the first live run, then run one monthly period and check the voucher references and totals by currency. High-risk (money-moving) runs still need the named human approval your AGENTS.md risk gate requires.

entries.title: What's New — this tab, generated from commits and change requests
entries.why: Changes were only visible in git history, which operators never read. Every implementation and change request deserves a plain-language record: why it exists, what changed, and what the reader must do.
entries.what: A new final tab lists every shipped change newest-first, with category, source (commit/PR/change request), Why / What / What you need to do, the console area to open, and risk. A generator turns future commit subjects and bodies into entries in exactly this shape, so filing a change becomes part of shipping it.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Check this tab after each release. When you ship a change, write the commit body as two paragraphs (why, then what) — it will be drafted into an entry automatically.

entries.title: Snowflake, Excel and Access warehouse connections — validated secrets, breach agreement, rotating PII masking
entries.why: The warehouse could export CSV/JSON and describe BI connectors, but Snowflake, Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Access pipelines need governed connections: a secret that is validated but never displayed, a signed data-breach agreement before any sync, and a guarantee that no real customer information reaches an analyst tool.
entries.what: The Data warehouse tab gains a Connections & PII masking section for Snowflake, Excel and Access. Registering a connection requires the current data-breach agreement (version, signer, date), stores only a SHA-256 fingerprint of the secret (the secret itself is never shown or returned), and runs a step-by-step validation (shape, secret strength, agreement, target) with an expiry. Every sample, export and connection preview is PII-masked with a one-way keyed hash whose method rotates on every transaction — the same customer masks differently in every drop, there is no decode function, and per-transaction salts are never exported.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Have your data-protection owner accept the current breach agreement, put connection secrets in your secret store (never in a ticket), register and validate each Snowflake/Excel/Access connection, and re-point BI tools at masked extracts. Never join two extracts on a masked value — masking rotates per transaction on purpose.

entries.title: Application theme — now a top-level tab
entries.source: PR #11 · commit f8eb9e8 (merged 02806d2) · PR #10 · commit a6468eb
entries.why: Theme onboarding existed — entity, partner and omni-channel brand layers with AI-assisted palettes — but it lived inside Master settings, so brand owners could not find it and reasonably reported it missing.
entries.what: A new Application theme tab brings the three existing panels to the top level: entity theme (applies globally), partner theme and omni-channel theme (both scoped to partner detail, the customer journey and quotation). Upload a logo/header/footer, let the local palette assistant sample dominant colours, review the swatches, generate, preview, enable/disable — and the console shell re-skins immediately. The Master settings sections remain in place.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Open Application theme, upload your entity logo, review the generated palette for contrast, and generate. Partner and channel owners should file their scoped layers there too, then check the Customer journey to see the scoped surface.

entries.title: Data warehouse — nine lineage-bearing datasets for analysts
entries.why: Analysts were screenshotting operational screens. They need one read model with grain, lineage and fingerprinted exports that never becomes a second ledger.
entries.what: Nine datasets (policy, premium, fund NAV, claim, reinsurance, commission schedule, super, voucher lines, member balances) with source, grain, sample rows and lineage; five native dashboard definitions; full CSV/JSON exports with content fingerprints; connector recipes for Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Databricks and Data Fabric.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Use exports from the Data warehouse tab rather than screen copies, and record the fingerprint with anything you publish. External BI sessions still need your deployment credentials — see WN-0005 for governed Snowflake/Excel/Access connections and masking.

entries.title: Funds accounting, super funds and event-based vouchers
entries.why: Accounting treatment differed by country and fund but was implicit. Finance needs the mapping from a policy event to a balanced debit/credit voucher to be filed data, not code.
entries.what: Country accounting standards, fund rules and dynamic mappings (event × product × partner × channel × policy) resolve every event — premium, deposit, accrual, allocation, gain/loss, withdrawal, charge — into a balanced voucher linked to a ledger journal. Super funds add monthly charges and pro-rata income allocation through the same vouchers. The Batch processing tab (WN-0007) now schedules these event types over the whole book.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Finance should review the filed mappings in Funds accounting before relying on batch runs, and check that every batch voucher reference traces to a balanced voucher.

entries.title: The guided customer journey, tenant master settings and the AI guide
entries.why: A sale crossed nineteen screens with no enforced order, and every tenant hardcoded its own country, currency and vocabulary.
entries.what: Nineteen gated journey sections that unlock only at 100% completion, tenant master settings (39 country packs, currencies, field renaming, the 96-product factory, rating tables, omni-channel commission/clawback), and an AI guide note on every section with a filed on/off switch.
entries.whatYouNeedToDo: Set your country, calendar and currencies in Master settings first — every other screen reads them. Use the guide switch in the header if you want the notes hidden; the change is audited.

dataBreachAgreement.terms: By accepting, the connecting party agrees: (1) warehouse data is received PII-masked only and re-identification is prohibited; (2) any suspected breach is notified to the insurer security desk within 24 hours and the connection is suspended until cleared; (3) masked extracts are never joined across transactions to re-identify a person (masking rotates per transaction by design); (4) secrets live in the deployment secret store, are rotated at least every 90 days, and are never pasted into tickets, chats or commits; (5) on termination all extracts are deleted and deletion is certified in writing.

masking.algorithm: SHA-256 keyed hash with per-transaction derived salt (one-way, no decode path)
masking.piiColumns: party/member/employer identifiers, names, email, phone, national IDs and secrets
masking.note: Masking is one-way (SHA-256 keyed hash, per-transaction derived salt). The method rotates on every transaction, salts are never exported, and there is no decode/unmask path in the codebase.

note.title: Tour
note.headline: Sixty minutes, in the order the money moves
note.body: The tour is data, not prose: every step names a tab, what to press and what you should see, and the whole thing adds up to exactly one hour. Run it top to bottom on a fresh demo world and you will have touched every engine.
doThis: Start on Overview and read the tenant card before touching anything.
Follow each step on its own tab rather than reading ahead.
Reset the demo data at the end and run it again to see the same numbers come back.
note.watch: The tour describes what the engine did, not what it will do for a different tenant: the figures come from the world in memory.

note.title: Access & DOA
note.headline: Thirty-six roles, three-tier RBAC, AI advisor and live DOA routing
note.body: Every operator enters through the role security layer — from Administration (complete unrestricted access) through technical desks (Underwriting, Retention, Endorsement, Claims, Settlement, Reinsurance, Finance, Cost Control, Fund Config & Investment) to Agency, Marsh Broker, Bancassurance, Branch, Aggregator, Direct Customer and Referral Partners. These are roles, not user accounts: a future login layer will provision named users against them. AI recommends optimal Tabs, Sections and Sub-Sections with Segregation-of-Duties checks, while Entity × Channel × Sub-Channel mappings route out-of-limit actions to the right supervisor with instant approver notifications.
doThis: Switch between roles or launch the Pre-Load Role Gate to experience each role’s tailored workspace and landing screen.
Run the AI Access & SoD Advisor on any role to inspect confidence scores, toxic-combination checks and one-click apply.
Test a DOA request above an officer’s cap and watch the notification land in the mapped Supervisor / Manager inbox for approval or escalation.
note.watch: Administration holds permanent complete access and cannot lock itself out; no requester may self-approve their own DOA request. Only supervisor- or manager-tier roles may change a DOA limit — an officer can only raise a limit-increase request.

note.title: Role access matrix
note.headline: Enable or disable any tab, section or sub-section — per role
note.body: This is the role-driven tree the console enforces: select a role, then switch each Tab, Section and Sub-Section between Full (visible and editable), Read-only (visible, not editable) and Hidden (not rendered in that role’s navigation). Children inherit from their parent until you override them, and changing a parent re-seats the whole branch so a hidden section can never leak a visible sub-section. These are roles — the policy office, the underwriter, the branch officer — not user logins. Named user accounts, credentials and login will reference a role id when the user-profile layer lands.
doThis: Pick a role on the left and read its Officer / Supervisor / Manager tier: tier decides who may change access and DOA limits, not what the role sells or underwrites.
Toggle a tab to Hidden and watch its sections and sub-sections inherit the change; then grant one sub-section Read and see it appear as the only explicit exception.
Open the DOA limits section: supervisors and managers edit caps for lower-tier roles; officer-tier roles see a limit-increase request form instead of an editor.
note.watch: Officer-tier roles cannot change section visibility or DOA limits at all, and nobody can grant more access than they hold themselves. Approval of an officer’s limit-increase request is what moves the cap; the requester never moves it directly.
