note.title: Customer journey
note.headline: The sale on rails: nineteen sections, one open — with zero duplicate entry
note.body: This is the front door of the ERP. Every section starts closed; the one the engine recommends opens itself, and the next one opens only when this one is 100% complete on its mandatory fields and its domain gates. Previously provided customer data — DOB, actuarial age (Nearest / Next / Last), height, weight, smoker status, income and dependent riders/products — auto-picks automatically across sections.
doThis: Pick an existing customer or enter DOB once and watch age, build, contact and dependent riders auto-populate downstream.
Work the open section, then submit it and watch the next one open itself.
Reopen a completed section and clear a mandatory field: the refusal names the field.
note.watch: Conditional, legal and regulatory requirements stay hard gates. Master settings can relax an ordinary required flag; they cannot relax a rule the pack insists on.

note.title: Master settings & ERP
note.headline: Change what the whole system means, without a release
note.body: Master settings is where the tenant is configured: country, calendar, time zone and currencies, actuarial age auto-calculation (Age Nearest / Age Next / Age Last) with per-product overrides, dependent product & rider auto-pick rules, smart editable combo-box suggestions, the product shelf grid, rating tables, omni-channel and partner commissions, multi-country providers, unit-linked charges, takaful window, claims authority matrix, FX rate card and regulated vocabulary.
doThis: Set country, region, time zone, currencies and actuarial age calculation basis (ANB / ANxB / ALB) first: every quote and customer auto-pick reads them.
Define or re-file a product in the factory grid with smart combo-box names/descriptions and configure its auto-picked dependent riders.
If the omni-channel is not set up, the button files the six standard routes; then the partners, their shelves, commission and clawback are yours to file.
Rename a journey field or a vocabulary label and watch the change reach the screens that render it.
note.watch: These settings are filed data with an audit trail, not preferences: a change here re-prices new business and re-words documents, so it is recorded with the actor and the time.

Policy issuance leaves from the issuance desk, the information pack from information, the renewal request from retention, alterations from alterations, claims from claims and reinsurance from reinsurance.

Open an event route and check the sending account, recipients, subject and body against the wording the regulator expects for that letter.
Preview an event with a real context, then send a test through the attached transport and read the delivery answer.
note.watch: Credentials are referenced by setting name and never stored here. A configured route is not a delivery: the transport still answers sent, failed or not-sent, and the answer is recorded against the document.

note.title: Cover control
note.headline: Pay for cover only while cover is on
note.body: Daily and pay-as-you-go cover as a billing primitive: a day is either paid or cover suspends, and nothing restarts by itself. The wallet, the segments and the statement are all here, and the charge for a stopped day is zero.
doThis: Read the segments: start, stop, daily rate, what has been charged.
Stop cover, advance the clock and watch nothing accrue.
Empty the wallet and tick again: cover suspends instead of going negative.
note.watch: Auto-start is off unless the customer elected it in writing — a renewal nobody asked for is a complaint waiting to happen.

note.title: Batch processing
note.headline: Run the whole book on a schedule, with the accounting filed first
note.body: Quotation generation, illustration generation, policy issuance and every monthly-anniversary event — mortality, premium accrual, commission accrual and clawback, fund management charges and dividend distribution — are batch jobs here. Each event is set up once with its debit/credit accounts, schedule, basis and applicable statuses; a run then processes quotations and policies one by one and reports posted, skipped, duplicate and failed items with voucher references.
doThis: Review the event setup table with Finance before the first live run: no setup, no run.
Pick an event and a period (YYYY-MM for anniversaries, YYYY-MM-DD for generation jobs) and run it.
Read the run lines: terminal subjects must show skipped-terminal, and re-running the same period must show duplicate-skipped, never a second charge.
note.watch: A policy leaves every batch the moment it lapses, is fully withdrawn or is surrendered. Clawback is the deliberate exception: it targets leavers to recover commission. Money-moving batches are high-risk under the AGENTS.md gate and need a named human approver outside this demo.

note.title: Takaful
note.headline: A takaful window that is structural, not cosmetic
note.body: Three funds, a real wakalah fee, tabarru’ into the participant risk fund, qard hasan when the pool is short, and a surplus that cannot be distributed until the actuary, the Shariah Committee and the board have all signed — with the UAE rule that participants never receive surplus applied on top.

Try to distribute the surplus and read the blockers one by one.
Sign as actuary, then Shariah, then board, and watch the blockers fall away.
note.watch: Participant money and shareholder money stay apart. A posting that mixes them is refused, not adjusted.

note.title: Underwriting
note.headline: Rules, decision and authority — kept apart
note.body: The manual scores the risk; the decision says what the risk merits; the authority says who may sign it. An AI agent may accept, rate or exclude inside its own limit and may never decline one — a decline, a postponement or anything above the limit becomes a referral to a named human.
doThis: Register a proposal and read the reasons, each with the source that produced it.
Read the reinsurance line: automatic or facultative, and the threshold behind it.
Take the decision and check the authority that was allowed to take it.
note.watch: Anything above the automatic binding limit is flagged for the reinsurer before issue — finding it after issue is how a treaty gets breached.

note.title: Claims
note.headline: Pay a claim through authority, not through a spreadsheet
note.body: Request, triage, reserve, decision, settlement and recovery, each step recorded with who took it and what limit allowed them to. A payout above a limit routes to a named human; an AI agent may triage inside its own limit and may never approve one.
doThis: Register a claim and read the triage: cover in force, exclusions, days late, fraud signals.
Set a reserve with a rationale, then take the decision inside the authority table.
Settle and record a recovery, and check the journals each step produced.
note.watch: Approving or paying a claim is on the AI prohibited list. A refused action stays refused and stays on the record.

note.title: Durability
note.headline: A demo that cannot survive a restart is not an ERP
note.body: The books are sealed into a canonical, fingerprinted snapshot and rebuilt from that text into a fresh world; the reporting registers are sealed, replayed and checked one by one, with a hash-chained outbox proving nothing was dropped between snapshots.
doThis: Read the snapshot summary: accounts, journals, size, fingerprint.
Run the durability drill and read the per-entity result.
Rebuild every register from the snapshot and read what came back.
note.watch: The fingerprint is stable across runs, so a tampered payload would be caught — and a restore that disagrees halts the module.

master:provider-selling.body: The channel, the sub-channel and the partner each carry a Conventional and a Takaful checkbox. role-matrix:role-directory.title: Role directory
role-matrix:role-directory.headline: Roles, not user accounts — and the tier that governs them
role-matrix:role-directory.body: Every row here is a role template (policy office, underwriter, branch officer, fund investment manager) with an authority tier. Officer roles do the operational work; supervisor roles approve first line; manager roles approve second line; Administration is the executive owner. role-matrix:access-tree.title: Access tree
role-matrix:access-tree.headline: The Tab → Section → Sub-Section switchboard
role-matrix:access-tree.body: Each tab is a branch; its sections are nodes under it and each section has its own sub-sections. Full means visible and editable, Read means visible but locked, Hidden means the node is not shown at all. A node without an explicit override shows "inherit" and follows its parent. Changing a tab clears child overrides so the whole branch moves together; granting a child afterwards creates one deliberate exception.
doThis: Choose the role first; the tree always edits that role, never the signed-in role by accident.
Use "Hidden" on a tab to remove it from the role’s navigation entirely, then open a section and grant Read to keep one reporting view visible.
Watch the effective-level badge next to each node: it is what the engine will actually enforce, including inherited levels.
role-matrix:access-tree.watch: Hiding a node is not the same as refusing an API call; the API still applies the same role checks, and an officer cannot edit this tree at all.

role-matrix:doa-limits.title: Doa limits
role-matrix:doa-limits.headline: DOA caps move at supervisor or manager level — officers request
role-matrix:doa-limits.body: A DOA cap is a decimal money limit with a currency. Supervisor- and manager-tier roles may change caps for lower-tier roles, but never above their own cap; Administration may set any finite cap and holds unlimited authority itself. An officer-tier role cannot edit a cap or this tree — it raises a tracked limit-increase request, routed through the Entity × Channel × Sub-Channel supervisor chain, and the approving supervisor/manager is what applies the new cap.
doThis: As a supervisor or manager, pick a lower-tier role, enter the new cap and save; read the refusal if it exceeds your own authority.
As an officer, use the request form: state the requested cap and the operational reason, then follow the tracked request in the approver inbox.
Approve a pending limit-increase request as the assigned supervisor and verify the role’s cap, audit trail and requester notification all change together.
role-matrix:doa-limits.watch: Self-approval is refused, an approver above their own cap auto-escalates, and an officer can never grant itself a higher limit by calling the API directly.

Credentials are read from the environment by the names filed here and are never stored, displayed or exported by the portal. rules.branch: A provider may only sell through a country in which it holds a registered, licensed branch.
rules.licence: The branch licence and the provider permission must both cover the product book being sold.
rules.reinsurance: Every provider/country pair needs its own reinsurance arrangement; Takaful business needs retakaful.
rules.currency: The product filing, the branch and the channel-country presence must all be in the country’s own currency.
rules.permission: Conventional and Takaful are separate permissions at channel, sub-channel and partner level; the effective permission is the narrowest of the three.
rules.money: Premium is managed by the local branch and the investment is held in the country where the quotation was generated.

example.description: Marsh Broker (call centre: conventional + Takaful; agency desk: conventional only) selling three carriers in the UAE, the UK and Singapore, each in its own currency, with a registered branch and a country reinsurance arrangement per carrier.

options.label: Age Nearest Birthday (ANB — 6-month / half-year rule)
options.summary: Rounds to the closest birthday on the valuation date: adds 1 year once 6 months (or half the birthday year) have elapsed.

options.label: Age Next Birthday (ANxB — upcoming birthday age)
options.summary: Uses the age attained on the upcoming birthday (completed years + 1, or completed years if valued on the exact birthday).

options.label: Age Last Birthday (ALB — completed integer years)
options.summary: Uses exact completed years since date of birth as of the valuation date, with no upward rounding.

roles.name: Administration
roles.title: Chief Platform & Security Administrator (Complete Access)
roles.summary: Complete unrestricted superuser access across every console tab, section and sub-section, Master Settings, RBAC & DOA governance, and unlimited override authority.
roles.aiRationale: Root enterprise administrator: full read/write/approve across every operational, actuarial, financial and governance surface.

roles.name: Supervisor
roles.title: Cross-Operations & Distribution Supervisor
roles.summary: Cross-functional supervision over operational queues, customer journeys, escalations, AI human-in-the-loop reviews and first-line DOA approvals.
roles.aiRationale: Cross-desk queue oversight, human AI review, DOA inbox management, and read-only visibility into technical claims/underwriting.

roles.name: Configurator
roles.title: Product, Rating, Wording & Platform Configurator
roles.summary: Configures product shelf, tariff tables, age calculation rules (ANB/ANxB/ALB), dependent product rules, omni-channels, providers, email templates and branding.
roles.aiRationale: Full control over non-cash configuration surfaces while masking customer PII and blocking direct claim payouts or GL postings (SoD safe).

roles.name: Underwriter Officer
roles.title: Life, Medical & General Risk Underwriter Officer
roles.summary: Evaluates proposals, medical evidence, BMI/occupation loadings and issues standard/rated decisions within officer DOA; refers higher risks to Underwriter Manager.
roles.aiRationale: Full risk scoring, medical questionnaire review and standard binding up to 500k AED; escalates jumbo risks automatically to Underwriter Manager.

roles.name: Underwriter Manager
roles.title: Head of Underwriting & Chief Risk Signatory
roles.summary: Approves high-sum-assured proposals, substandard mortality loadings, medical waivers and agent/banca underwriting referrals up to treaty limits.
roles.aiRationale: Full underwriting authority up to 5M AED across Conventional & Takaful books, plus human sign-off on AI referrals and officer escalations.

roles.name: Retention Officer
roles.title: Policy Conservation & Renewal Retention Officer
roles.summary: Manages policy conservation, renewal outreach, surrender rescue illustrations, fund switches and fee-waiver concessions within retention officer DOA.
roles.aiRationale: Equipped with Decision Theatre switch/withdrawal previews, Policyholder conservation tools and Cover Control, escalating fee waivers >15k AED to Retention Manager.

roles.name: Retention Manager
roles.title: Head of Portfolio Persistency & Retention
roles.summary: Oversees renewal persistency, conservation campaigns, surrender rescue DOA concessions and retention email triggers across all channels.
roles.aiRationale: Approves retention waivers up to 150k AED with full visibility into persistency cohorts, renewal email routes and policyholder look-through.

roles.name: Endorsement Officer
roles.title: Policy Alterations & Endorsement Officer
roles.summary: Processes non-financial changes (address, beneficiary, contact) and financial endorsements (sum assured, riders, payment frequency) within DOA.
roles.aiRationale: Direct access to Policyholder alterations, Customer 360 updates and Cover segments; financial alterations above 50k AED route to Endorsement Supervisor.

roles.name: Endorsement Supervisor
roles.title: Policy Servicing & Endorsement Supervisor
roles.summary: Supervises policy servicing SLAs and approves high-value financial alterations, backdated endorsements and beneficiary overrides.
roles.aiRationale: Approves financial endorsements up to 500k AED and escalates underwriting-impacting increases above 500k AED to Underwriter Manager.

roles.name: Claim Officer
roles.title: Claims FNOL, Triage & Assessment Officer
roles.summary: Registers FNOL claims, verifies cover/exclusions, sets initial technical reserves and approves straightforward claims up to officer DOA.
roles.aiRationale: Segregation of Duties enforced: Claim Officer assesses & approves within 50k AED but cash disbursement belongs to Settlement Desk; >50k AED routes to Claim Manager.

roles.name: Claim Manager
roles.title: Head of Claims Adjudication & Technical Reserves
roles.summary: Adjudicates complex/high-severity Conventional & Takaful claims, signs off reserves, declines invalid claims with rationale and triggers reinsurance recovery.
roles.aiRationale: Full adjudication authority up to 500k AED across Conventional & Takaful pools while preserving four-eyes separation from Settlement cash release.

roles.name: Settlement Officer
roles.title: Claims, Maturity & Surrender Settlement Officer
roles.summary: Verifies discharge vouchers, payee IBAN/KYC and releases approved claim, maturity and surrender settlements up to officer disbursement DOA.
roles.aiRationale: Four-eyes payout control: executes settlement disbursements up to 100k AED on already-adjudicated claims and routes larger releases to Settlement Manager.

roles.name: Settlement Manager
roles.title: Head of Disbursements, Settlements & Subrogation
roles.summary: Authorizes high-value claim payouts, maturity/surrender batch disbursements, salvage/subrogation recoveries and treasury payment releases.
roles.aiRationale: High-value settlement release up to 2M AED with visibility into GL books, batch payment runs and reinsurance recoveries.

roles.name: Reinsurance Officer
roles.title: Treaty Administration, Cession & Facultative Officer
roles.summary: Administers quota-share/surplus/XOL cessions, retakaful treaties, facultative placements, cash calls and LOC security tracking within officer DOA.
roles.aiRationale: Full access to treaty bordereaux, facultative placement prep and collateral monitoring up to 1M AED; routes treaty changes & >1M placements to Reinsurance Manager.

roles.name: Reinsurance Manager
roles.title: Head of Reinsurance, Retakaful & Counterparty Security
roles.summary: Approves treaty structures, net retention limits, jumbo facultative bindings, catastrophe reinstatements, cash calls and regulatory reinsurance filings.
roles.aiRationale: Authorizes ceded placements & security releases up to 10M AED with full UAE reinsurance rule-book and statutory return access.

roles.name: Bancassurance Operations Officer
roles.title: Bancassurance Middle-Office & Bank Feed Operations Officer
roles.summary: Reconciles daily bank feed files, clears quarantined rows, supports bank policy issuance, bank direct-debit batch runs and branch servicing requests.
roles.aiRationale: Tailored for bank middle-office operations: Ingestion feed reconciliation, KYC queue, Policy issuance & Batch sweeps, reporting to Banca Supervisor.

roles.name: Fund Configuration
roles.title: Unit-Linked & Superannuation Fund Configuration Specialist
roles.summary: Configures unit-linked funds, Super investment products, dealing cut-offs, FMC basis points, Shariah screening flags and fund-to-product mappings.
roles.aiRationale: Focused control over Funds, Super Funds and Fund Accounting rules while escalating live fee or valuation sign-offs >250k AED to Fund Investment Manager.

roles.name: Accountant
roles.title: Financial & Policy Ledger Accountant
roles.summary: Maintains chart of accounts mappings, posts balanced vouchers, verifies trial balances, runs monthly accounting batches and prepares statutory extracts.
roles.aiRationale: Full access to double-entry Books, Funds Accounting vouchers and scheduled Batch postings within 100k AED; >100k AED routes to Finance.

roles.name: Finance
roles.title: Head of Finance, Group Consolidation & Treasury
roles.summary: Governs multi-entity IFRS/local consolidation, FX translation reserves, intercompany eliminations, treasury releases, statutory filings and accounting approvals.
roles.aiRationale: Full group finance, ledger proof, voucher approval up to 2.5M AED and cryptographic durability verification.

roles.name: Cost Controller
roles.title: Acquisition Cost, Commission, Fee & AI Spend Controller
roles.summary: Controls partner/channel commission schedules, clawback rules, policy admin/allocation charges, expense budgets and AI token/agent spend governance.
roles.aiRationale: Pinpoint visibility into commission schedules, charge tables, clawback batches, warehouse cost lineage and AI spend telemetry.

roles.name: Fund Investment Officer
roles.title: Portfolio Valuation, NAV Pricing & Dealing Officer
roles.summary: Records daily market instrument prices, runs unit-linked NAV calculations, checks Shariah asset screens and executes member dealing allocations.
roles.aiRationale: Operational NAV valuation, look-through pricing and Super investment runs up to 500k AED; escalates seed/rebalance sign-off to Fund Investment Manager.

roles.name: Fund Investment Manager
roles.title: Chief Investment Officer & Fund Governance Approver
roles.summary: Approves daily NAV publication exceptions, Super fund income/loss distributions, Shariah portfolio purification actions and fund launches up to 10M AED.
roles.aiRationale: Full investment governance across Unit-Linked, Takaful PIF and Superannuation portfolios with 10M AED DOA authority.

roles.name: Agent 1
roles.title: Tied Life & Wealth Advisor — Agency Desk 1 (Conventional)
roles.summary: Conducts customer onboarding, fact-find needs analysis, suitability recommendations, benefit illustrations, quotations and proposal submissions on Agency Desk 1.
roles.aiRationale: Frontline sales productivity on Agency Desk 1 without underwriting self-approval; quotes >250k AED or fee concessions notify Agent Supervisor immediately.

roles.name: Agent 2
roles.title: Family Takaful & Protection Advisor — Agency Desk 2
roles.summary: Advises Conventional & Family Takaful clients on Agency Desk 2 across customer onboarding, Shariah-screened fund illustrations and policy applications.
roles.aiRationale: Scoped to Agency Desk 2 with Takaful pool read visibility for transparent Wakalah/Tabarru client disclosures; supervised by Agent Supervisor.

roles.name: Agent Marsh
roles.title: Marsh Multinational Broker Producer (UAE / UK / Singapore Shelf)
roles.summary: Places multinational corporate & high-net-worth risks under licensed Marsh Call-Centre and Marsh Agency sub-channels with country/currency sellability enforcement.
roles.aiRationale: Aligned with the Marsh multi-country broker setup (Conventional allowed on MARSH-AGENCY; both books on MARSH-CALL-CENTRE) with 1M AED broker quote threshold.

roles.name: Agent Supervisor
roles.title: Agency & Broker Distribution Supervisor (Approver)
roles.summary: Supervises Agent 1, Agent 2 and Agent Marsh across Agency & Broker channels; approves commission concessions, large quotes and rider waivers up to 1.5M AED.
roles.aiRationale: First-line DOA approver for all Agency & Marsh broker producers up to 1.5M AED, escalating technical risk decisions above cap to Underwriter Manager.

roles.name: Banca Officer 1
roles.title: Bancassurance Wealth Specialist — Premier Bank Desk 1
roles.summary: Originates unit-linked wealth, mortgage protection and endowment plans for premier bank customers on Bancassurance Desk 1.
roles.aiRationale: Scoped to BANCA-PREMIER-1 with customer auto-pick, fund look-through visibility and 300k AED straight-through quote cap; reports to Banca Supervisor.

roles.name: Banca Officer 2
roles.title: Bancatakaful & Retail Protection Specialist — Islamic Bank Desk 2
roles.summary: Originates Family Takaful savings, credit takaful and retail protection plans on Bancassurance Islamic Desk 2.
roles.aiRationale: Scoped to BANCA-ISLAMIC-2 with Shariah fund & Takaful pool visibility; routes >300k AED cases automatically to Banca Supervisor.

roles.name: Banca Supervisor
roles.title: Bancassurance Channel Supervisor (Approver)

roles.aiRationale: Supervises all bancassurance specialists and feed operations up to 1.5M AED, escalating larger private-bank cases to Bank Manager.

roles.name: Branch Officer
roles.title: Retail Bank Branch Insurance Officer

roles.aiRationale: Streamlined branch desk footprint with 150k AED walk-in DOA; cases above 150k AED notify Branch Manager immediately.

roles.name: Branch Manager
roles.title: Bank Branch Manager — BranchBancassurance Approver

roles.aiRationale: Approves retail branch referrals up to 750k AED and escalates HNW/corporate bank cases cleanly to Bank Manager.

roles.name: Bank Manager
roles.title: Executive Head of Partner Bank & Multi-Branch Network

roles.aiRationale: Top distribution governance across the entire bank partnership up to 5M AED with full warehouse analytics and multi-branch supervision.

roles.name: Aggregator
roles.title: Digital Comparison & API Aggregator Partner

roles.aiRationale: Strictly isolated digital aggregator surface: instant quoting, comparison matrix and micro-cover without back-office ledger or cross-customer PII access.

roles.name: Direct Customer
roles.title: Self-Service Policyholder & Direct Digital Customer

roles.name: Referral Partner 2
roles.title: Corporate & Affinity Introducer — Referral Partner 2
